title: Grateful Dead Live at Rhode Island Auditorium on 1971-04-21
lineage: SBD > MR > R > DAT > CD > DAE > SHN > shntool > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy ’71 show with smoking Wharf Rat, Hard to Handle and The Other One performances.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard source that, despite occasional hiss complaints, sounds tight and clear.  Musically the concert shines – Jerry’s sparkling leads on Wharf Rat, the blistering guitar break in Hard to Handle and a tightly‑woven Other One make this a standout early‑’71 performance.  The band is loose enough to stay exciting but disciplined enough to keep every song tight.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating ~4.6 from 14 reviews, overwhelmingly positive comments about both performance and sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mostly praised as crisp and tight; a few reviewers note minor hiss typical of the era but it does not detract from overall clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid set structure with tight transitions (e.g., Truckin → Drums → Other One) and a balanced mix of blues, folk‑rock and jam sections; second set maintains momentum without any glaring weak spots.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for sparkling leads on Wharf Rat, blistering guitar break on Hard to Handle, strong vocals and overall elevated performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted driving bass lines especially on Cumberland and during jam sections; praised for ‘flying through’ the set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned lyrical contributions and intense vocal phrasing; his rhythm work is highlighted as solid throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ/harmonica work and vocals are called out as being at his best, adding a powerful backbone to the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann described as ‘on fire’ with wild‑man antics, providing energetic drum breaks that lift the jams.
